mapper.select: select file.PRJ_ID as prjId,a.NAME as prjName, file.STAGE_ID as stageId,e.NAME as stageName, file.SUB_ITEM_ID as subItemId,b.NAME as subItemName, file.PROFESSION_ID as professionId,f.NAME as professionName, u.NAME as userName from BIZ_CAD_TAG tag left join BIZ_CAD_FILE file on file.ID = tag.FILE_ID left join BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a on a.ID = file.PRJ_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM b on b.ID = file.SUB_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE e on e.ID = file.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION f on f.ID = file.PROFESSION_ID left join BIZ_CAD_USER u on u.ID = tag.OPR_USER ${ew.customSqlSegment}
